root_idea.summary: The root centers on encountering or imposing hardship, distress, and what is contrary to ease.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of severe difficulty, the lexicon develops causative uses for imposing hardship, and related uses for peril, wrongdoing, physical harm, and entangling difficulty.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the distinct Form IV causative verb.
Displayed as the noun citation form عَنَتٌ.

senses.definition: To fall into, experience, or suffer difficulty, hardship, or distress.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, the verb describes hardship or distress affecting the addressee or community. It may be used of what causes such difficulty.

senses.definition: To incur or commit sinful wrongdoing.
senses.usage_conditions: A secondary interpretation of ما عَنِتُّمْ in 3:118 understands the expression as referring to having sinned; this reading is distinct from the ordinary sense of experiencing hardship.

senses.definition: To cause someone to fall into hardship or distress; to impose a severe constraint or demand.
senses.usage_conditions: In لَأَعْنَتَكُمْ, the causative verb can describe imposing a burden or requiring what is difficult, or beyond one's power, to perform.

senses.definition: To destroy or cause to perish.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an alternative interpretation of لَأَعْنَتَكُمْ in 2:220, presenting the imposed hardship as destruction or ruin.

senses.definition: Severe hardship, distress, or peril, including the prospect of ruin.
senses.usage_conditions: In خَشِيَ الْعَنَتَ, the noun denotes a feared condition of severe difficulty or peril; some interpretations specifically explain it as perdition or destruction.

senses.definition: Fornication or adultery, understood as grave sexual sin.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional Quranic interpretation of الْعَنَتَ in 4:25; some explanations describe the meaning as perdition through fornication rather than the act alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a beast: to become lame or halt because of harsh or rough treatment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical use describing impairment resulting from treatment the animal cannot bear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bone: to weaken and break, or to break again after having been set and united.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a previously treated fracture or of a bone that becomes weak after being set.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat someone with hardness or severity and constrain him to do what is difficult for him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form II causative/intensive use, distinct from the Quranic Form IV form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To destroy someone or cause him to perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended Form II use in which severe treatment results in ruin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat a beast roughly so that it becomes lame or halts; to treat a sick person without gentleness and injure him; or to worsen a previously set fracture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical Form IV causative use involving harsh handling and resulting harm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring annoyance, molestation, harm, or hurt upon someone, or to seek to cause him difficulty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V use describing deliberate or troublesome imposition of harm or hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To question someone in a way intended to entangle him in confusion or doubt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of pressing a witness or another person with searching questions designed to create uncertainty or expose him to difficulty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the horn of a young goat: to rise or rise high.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized rural or zoological use of the R.Q. form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn away from, avoid, or shun someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate use of the same rare form, construed with عَنْهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bad, evil, or corrupt state, or bad, evil, or corrupt conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader moral and behavioral noun use outside the specific Quranic interpretation retained above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sin, crime, or act of disobedience deserving punishment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This general moral sense is broader than the specifically sexual Quranic interpretation of 4:25.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wrong action, error, or mistake, whether intentional or unintentional.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general noun for erroneous or wrongful action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wrongful, unjust, injurious, or tyrannical conduct; annoyance, harm, hurt, or afflicting injury.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This branch emphasizes harmful treatment or conduct rather than hardship simply as a condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Contention, especially striving for superiority, persistent opposition, or vain disputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or interpersonal use attributed to the relevant lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bone broken after having been set and united.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a previously treated bone that has fractured again.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hill difficult to ascend; a high and difficult ascent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A topographical adjective or noun describing steepness and difficulty of ascent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The notch in a bow into which the ring at the head of the string enters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term for a part of a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first part, beginning, or commencement of anything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use unrelated to the Quranic forms displayed above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dry plant called حَلِيّ or حَلْي.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical use recorded as a separate lexical branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for a woman, equivalent to عَانِسٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence presents this as a dialectal, substituted, or possibly mispronounced form; it is retained as a distinct lexical item.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of difficulty, hardship, or distress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun denoting the source or occasion of hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seeking to cause someone to fall into a wrong action, error, or wrongdoing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Illustrated in the phrase جَاءَنِي فُلَانٌ مُتَعَنِّتًا; the participle describes the person's intention toward the other party.

cautions: The Quranic noun in 4:25 retains two established interpretive readings: severe hardship or peril, and fornication or grave sexual sin.
The Form I occurrence in 3:118 is ordinarily understood as distress or hardship, while a secondary lexical interpretation understands ما عَنِتُّمْ as having sinned.
The expression عَنَتِ الْوُجُوهُ cited in the Quran-focused discussion is explicitly identified there as belonging to a different etymological باب and is not assigned to this root.
